concept.description: Labels @Entity classes as :Entity and stores the @Table schema / name (tableSchema, tableName).
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['jakarta.persistence.Entity', 'javax.persistence.Entity'] } OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(ta:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(tt:Type) WHERE tt.fqn IN ['jakarta.persistence.Table', 'javax.persistence.Table'] OPTIONAL MATCH (ta)-[:HAS]->(sv:Value {name: 'schema'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ta)-[:HAS]->(nv:Value {name: 'name'}) SET t:Entity, t.tableSchema = sv.value, t.tableName = nv.value RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS Entities

concept.description: Labels Spring Data repository interfaces (direct or inherited, through at most 3 application types, from an org.springframework.data *Repository type) as :Repository. Library types are not scanned, so the library supertype is matched by name.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:EXTENDS|IMPLEMENTS*1..3]->(s:Type) WHERE s.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.springframework.data.' AND s.fqn ENDS WITH 'Repository' SET t:Repository RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS Repositories

concept.description: Labels the save* / delete* / flush methods of Spring Data repositories and @Modifying queries as :RepositoryWrite.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type:Repository)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE (coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) STARTS WITH 'save' OR coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) STARTS WITH 'delete' OR coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'flush' OR EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying'}) }) SET m:RepositoryWrite RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS RepositoryWrites

constraint.description: Every @Entity must declare its database schema in @Table(schema = ...).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (e:Type:Entity) WHERE NOT e:Test AND coalesce(e.tableSchema, '') = '' RETURN e AS Element, e.fqn AS Fqn, 'no @Table(schema=...)' AS Detail

constraint.description: Two entities must not be mapped to the same table.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (e:Type:Entity) WHERE NOT e:Test AND e.tableName IS NOT NULL WITH coalesce(e.tableSchema, '') + '.' + e.tableName AS tbl, collect(e) AS entities WHERE size(entities) > 1 UNWIND entities AS e RETURN e AS Element, e.fqn AS Fqn, 'table ' + tbl + ' mapped by ' + toString(size(entities)) + ' entities' AS Detail

constraint.description: Entities should not store money / exact quantities in float or double: use BigDecimal.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (e:Type:Entity)-[:DECLARES]->(f:Field)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ft:Type) WHERE NOT e:Test AND ft.fqn IN ['double', 'float', 'java.lang.Double', 'java.lang.Float'] RETURN DISTINCT f AS Element, e.fqn AS Fqn, f.name + ' : ' + ft.fqn AS Detail

constraint.description: Entities without a @Version field have no optimistic locking.
Repository finders returning a List without Pageable / Sort / Top-N are unbounded: page them.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type:Repository)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE NOT t:Test AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) STARTS WITH 'find' AND m.signature STARTS WITH 'java.util.List ' AND NOT m.signature CONTAINS 'Pageable' AND NOT m.signature CONTAINS 'Sort' AND NOT coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) CONTAINS 'Top' AND NOT coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) CONTAINS 'First' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.signature AS Detail

MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.hibernate.envers.RevisionEntity'}) WHERE NOT t:Test WITH collect(DISTINCT t) AS revs WHERE size(revs) > 1 UNWIND revs AS t RETURN t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, toString(size(revs)) + ' revision entities' AS Detail
